description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag for rendering the store's logo URL within a web application. It constructs the URL based on session attributes, merchant store data, and configurations, defaulting to a placeholder image if no custom logo is set.

classes.name: StoreLogoUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag that outputs the store's logo URL based on store data, session configuration, and default images.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the URL for the store logo and writes it to the JSP output. Uses session and request attributes to build the URL, defaulting to a placeholder image if no store logo is set.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Performs cleanup after the tag processing; simply returns EVAL_PAGE.
